description: SYNTHETIC starter corpus for the behavioural (attack-graph / anomaly) surface. Event sequences, so the run covers more than the injection models.

labeling_protocol.adjudication: none — single author, no second opinion
labeling_protocol.method: authored-with-intent: each case was written to be an example of its declared label, so ground truth is the author's intent rather than an observation. This is the weakest labeling protocol there is and is acceptable ONLY because these corpora are explicitly synthetic.

provenance.authorization: none required — contains no customer, tenant, or personal data
provenance.license: BUSL-1.1 (same as the repository); no third-party data included
provenance.source: hand-authored by the AISP engineering team for harness development
